applied.problem: The rule of thumb says only a square factor comes out from under "the root", but this lesson also teaches cube roots, where a cube factor comes out (∛16 = 2∛2) and a square one does not (∛4 is not whole); narrowed to square roots.

"Only a square-number factor comes out" follows straight after the cube root ∛8 and is true only of square roots: under a cube root it is a cube-number factor that comes out, as lesson 4's roots will show; narrowed to a square root.
